name: uk-to-uae-relocation-tax
description: What happens to UK tax when a UK resident moves to Dubai or Abu Dhabi, for tax year 2026/27 (6 April 2026 to 5 April 2027). Covers the Statutory Residence Test for leavers, split-year Cases 1 to 3, the 5-year temporary non-residence rule (including the 2026 change that catches the full amount of close-company distributions to material participators), what stays UK-taxed (rent, UK property gains, UK work, government pensions), the UK-UAE treaty pension article, the residence-based inheritance tax tail from 6 April 2025, voluntary National Insurance after the April 2026 changes, and a departure checklist. Trigger phrases: moving to Dubai, UK to UAE tax, leave UK for Dubai, 5-year rule Dubai, IHT tail UAE, UK pension in Dubai, split year Dubai. Out of scope, see siblings: the residence test in full (uk-statutory-residence-test), filing as a non-resident (uk-non-resident-sa109), foreign tax credit and withholding (uk-foreign-tax-and-withholding), the FIG regime (uk-non-dom), UAE corporate
